title: CWP/1032/2025 of JAIDEEP AND OTHERS Vs STATE OF HARYANA AND OTHERS
text: IN THE HIGH COURT OF PUNJAB AND HARYANA AT CHANDIGARH Sr. No.117 Date of decision: 02.05.2025 Jaideep and others ....Petitioners Versus State of Haryana and others ....Respondents CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE DEEPAK SIBAL HON'BLE MS. JUSTICE LAPITA BANERJI Present: Mr. Vikram Singh Punia, Advocate (through VC) for the petitioners. Mr. Ankur Mittal, Addl. A.G., Haryana with Mr. P.P. Chahar, Sr. DAG, Haryana. Mr. Saurabh Mago, DAG, Haryana for respondents No.2 to 4. * * * DEEPAK SIBAL, J. (Oral) (1) Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that at this stage, he would be satisfied if the present writ petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 – Chief Administrator, Haryana Urban Development Authority/Haryana Shehri Vikas Pradhikaran, Panchkula to take a decision on the representation dated 05.03.2024 (Annexure P-2) made by the petitioners. (2) Learned State counsel has no objection if the petitioners' above prayer is accepted. (3) Accordingly, at this stage, without commenting on the merits of the case, the present petition is disposed of with a direction to respondent No.2 to take a decision on the aforesaid representation made by the chandigarh petitioners, by passing speaking order(s) and affording opportunity of hearing to all concerned within two months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order. (4) Needless to add that the decision so taken be communicated to the petitioners and if the same is not to the satisfaction of the petitioners, they would be at liberty to challenge the same, in accordance with law. (DEEPAK SIBAL) JUDGE (LAPITA BANERJI) JUDGE May 02, 2025 Jyoti 1 chandigarh
